reason: B is the better prospective proposal because it tests precipitate-mediated pinning as an extension of prior annealing and microstructure findings, whereas A essentially repeats the cited HPT experiment and its reported 50% coercivity increase in the same alloy. B remains under-specified in alloy composition, annealing window, and quantitative effect size, and must verify sufficient magnetic/anisotropy contrast at the coherent precipitates, but it offers greater novelty and a mechanism-resolving falsification test.
